registry_binding.qualification: 756 native experimental conditions; benzaldehyde is explicitly identified by the source as the main undesired by-product of styrene epoxidation. The task predicts its measured-spectrum-derived yield for a known candidate. Native fitted zero values are preserved as quantitative estimates and are not relabelled absence/not-detected. Desired-product yield and selectivity columns are excluded from model inputs. No generated candidates or interpolated viewer tables are used. One chemical transformation with a catalyst-composition panel; grouping must prevent repeated compositions crossing splits.
registry_binding.reference_evidence: Primary paper Figure6c–d and the 'Five-dimensional compositional space' section explicitly distinguish desired styrene oxide from benzaldehyde20b, the main by-product. Methods specify72°C/6h and UV–Vis spectral unmixing. Native summary README defines units and source CSV contains756 indexed catalyst-composition assays.

impurity_prediction.scope: One source-identified benzaldehyde side product; not an open-world impurity structure-discovery benchmark.
